host_clock_status: The host clock previously ran ahead of the user-reported local clock, so it remains unsuitable for uncorrected provenance timestamps.
anchor_semantics: This is a rounded monotonic audit anchor for the replacement chain, not a claim of exact wall-clock creation time.
correction: The replacement freeze must require the exact bound timestamp through VCC_PROVENANCE_UTC. Later artifact commands must also set an explicit August 31 UTC provenance value rather than read the host clock.
